units.source_text: 岛村也从被炉里回过头来看了看，只见斜坡上的积雪花花搭搭的，五六个身穿黑色滑雪服的人在山麓那头的旱地里滑着。

en.t: Shimamura also turned his head from the kotatsu to look, and saw that the snow on the slope lay in patches, while five or six people in black ski outfits were skiing through the dry fields down by the foot of the mountain.

units.source_text: 那边的梯田田埂还没被雪覆盖，而且坡度也不大，实在是没意思。

en.t: The ridges of the terraced fields over there were not yet covered with snow, and the slope was not steep either, so it was utterly uninteresting.
